data.name: Alexei
data.gender_notes: Alexei is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Alexei is a Greek name meaning 'helper of mankind' or 'defender of mankind'. In Christian tradition, it is the name of several saints, including Saint Alexis of Rome and Saint Alexis of Moscow. Alexis was a man of great faith and compassion, and he is remembered for his kindness, courage, and selflessness. The name Alexei carries the meaning “Defender of mankind” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Alexei usually hope their child will grow to embody defender of mankind and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Alexei belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Defender of mankind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alexei total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: אלכסיי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלכסיי הוא שם שמורכב מ'אלכס' שפירושו מגן ומ'אי' שפירושו אלוהים. הוא נגזר מהשם היווני 'אלכסאנדрос' שפירושו מגן האנשים. השם אלכסיי מופיע בתקופה של ימי הביניים וקשור לכנסייה האורתודוקסית הרוסית. הוא נחשב לשם של קדושים ומלכים רוסים.

in_greek.name: Αλέξης
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Αλέξης είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από το 'Αλέξανδρος', που σημαίνει 'ο υπερασπιστής του λαού'. Το όνομα αυτό ήταν πολύ δημοφιλές στην αρχαία Ελλάδα και συνδέεται με πολλούς βασιλιάδες και ευγενείς. Στην Εκκλησία Ορθόδοξης, ο Άγιος Αλέξης είναι ένας από τους πιο σεβαστούς αγίους.

historical_references.reference: Alexei I Mikhailovich of Russia, born in 1629, was the youngest son of Michael I of Russia and Xenia Godunova. He became Tsar in 1645, following the death of his brother, Tsar Vladimir IV, and ruled until 1676. Alexei is best known for his efforts to modernize Russia, including the introduction of a more effective taxation system and the creation of a standing army. He also initiated diplomatic relations with Europe, which helped to bring Russia into the larger European political sphere.

Alexander Alexeyevich, better known as Alexei Nikolayevich, born in 1899, was the eldest son of Tsar Nicholas II of Russia and Alexandra of Hesse and by Rhine. He was heir to the Russian throne but was executed, along with his family, by the Bolsheviks during the Russian Revolution in 1918. Alexei is remembered as a devoted and loving son, particularly towards his father, who was revered by the Russian people. His tragic end serves as a symbol of the end of the Romanov dynasty.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Alexei has strong associations with Russian Orthodox Christianity and Russia's political landscape. In contemporary culture, Alexei is a common name among Russian men. It is seen on various platforms including social media, television, and gaming. In religious contexts, Alexei is a common name for prominent figures in the Orthodox Church, such as Alexei II, who was the former patriarch of Moscow and All Russia. In politics, Alexei Navalny, an opposition leader and anti-corruption activist, has gained international recognition. In sports, Alexei Kovalev and Alexei Yashin are well-known Russian hockey players. The name Alexei has also been popularized in various media, such as the video game 'Company of Heroes 2', where Alexei Strelok is a protagonist, and the American television series 'The Americans', where Alexei Borev is a recurring character.
